newsitem.title: UK: SNOOKER-DOHERTY REACHES WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SNOOKER-DOHERTY REACHES WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP FINAL.

text.p: Ireland's Ken Doherty reached his first world snooker championship final when he crushed Canadian Alan Robidoux 17-7 on Friday.
Doherty took an 11-5 advantage into the evening session and wrapped up his semifinal success by winning five successive frames.
The Irishman will face either Thai James Wattana or defending champion Stephen Hendry of Scotland in the final.
Wattana clawed his way back from 7-3 down against Hendry to end the day level at 8-8 in the best-of-33 frames contest.
Hendry led 5-3 overnight and put further daylight between himself and his opponent when he won the opening two frames of the afternoon.
His break of 101 in the 10th frame of the match was the 33rd at the tournament.
But Wattana, not renowned for his ability to stage inspired comebacks, won five of the remaining six frames.
His best break was of 82 in the penultimate frame.
